correctness.rationale: A proper coloring of K_{2,m} yields two injective color lists and hence a fixed-point-free partial injection recording cross-list coincidences. For even m=2t with t>=6, two bipartite perfect matchings produce a rainbow P5 edge-decomposition; the second allowed graph is K_{t,t} minus at most three matchings, so its minimum degree is at least t-3>=t/2 and Hall applies. Odd m follows by removing one large-side vertex. The degree-m vertex gives the matching lower bound ceil(m/2).

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The direct 2026 source arXiv:2609.18740 proves only an asymptotic complete-multipartite formula, specializing to (1+o(1))m/2 for K_{2,m}. Exact and synonymous searches found no prior eventual equality or prescribed-middle rainbow P5 decomposition. The source is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a new asymptotic theorem to an exact formula on an infinite highly unbalanced complete-bipartite family and strengthens it to an explicit rainbow edge-decomposition with prescribed middle vertices and a polynomial-time construction.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
